page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g9it.8xlarge is an x86_64 instance type within the Enhanced family, operating on the KVM hypervisor. Compute is provided by 32 dedicated vCPUs powered by an Intel Xeon 6982P-C processor operating at 3.2 GHz. The memory subsystem provides 128.0 GB of RAM, yielding a balanced 1:4 compute-to-memory distribution of 4.0 GB per vCPU. Hardware acceleration is absent, with no integrated or dedicated GPUs present on the instance.

Storage and networking configurations align with standard disaggregated cloud models. The instance includes no local storage disks, requiring external cloud block storage for the operating system and persistent data. Ingress and egress connectivity are supported by a 28 Gbps baseline network bandwidth. The instance is provisioned with zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses, relying on internal VPC networking or assigned Elastic IP resources for connectivity.

The 1:4 memory allocation paired with dedicated 3.2 GHz processor cores provides stable execution for enterprise applications that do not depend on local disk scratch space. The architecture is suited for container nodes, web application tiers, microservice clusters, middleware systems, and backend relational databases operating against network-attached block volumes.
